# filename: clean_type_mapping.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"
raw_tables = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
df = pd.concat(raw_tables, ignore_index=True)

possible_types = ["Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"]

current_type = None
assigned = []
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    name = str(row.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if name in possible_types:
        current_type = name
        assigned.append(None)
    else:
        assigned.append(current_type)

df['Type'] = assigned

# Filter out header rows and keep rows with numeric ratings
clean_df = df[(df['Type'].notnull()) & (df['Rating (out of 5)'].notnull())]
final_df = clean_df[['Name', 'Type', 'Rating (out of 5)']].copy()

print(final_df.head(15))
print("\nCounts by Type:\n", final_df['Type'].value_counts())
```

# filename: summarize_trimmed.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"
raw_tables = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
df = pd.concat(raw_tables, ignore_index=True)

possible_types = ["Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"]
current_type = None
assigned = []
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    name = str(row.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if name in possible_types:
        current_type = name
        assigned.append(None)
    else:
        assigned.append(current_type)

df['Type'] = assigned
clean_df = df[(df['Type'].notnull()) & (df['Rating (out of 5)'].notnull())]
final_df = clean_df[['Name', 'Type', 'Rating (out of 5)']].copy()

# Apply quick quality filter: drop ratings < 2.0
trimmed = final_df[final_df['Rating (out of 5)'] >= 2.0]
summary = trimmed.groupby('Type').agg(
    Number_of_Listings=('Name', 'count'),
    Average_Rating=('Rating (out of 5)', 'mean')
).reset_index()

print(summary)
```
